description: The Hughes Crypto Kernel (HCK) for Hughes HN and HX systems enables end-to-end bidirectional encryption between a remote site and the enterprise data center, while still allowing the use of satellite acceleration and other HN and HX features. The HCK uses AES for encryption and IKE to auto-generate and refresh session keys.
